title: Schneider Electric Interactive Graphical SCADA System Software
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW UNCONTROLLED SEARCH PATH ELEMENT CWE-427 The software will execute a malicious file if it is named the same as a legitimate file and placed in a location that is earlier in the search path. CVE-2017-6033 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.8 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). RESEARCHER Karn Ganeshen reported this vulnerability. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing, Energy Area Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: France This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
